faq: Will a new listing improve my ranking?
We cannot promise rankings, because stores weigh many things we do not control. We write clear, relevant text and strong screenshots, which help people understand and install your app.
Do you need screenshots from me?
A test build or a few raw screen captures are enough. We frame them in device mockups, add captions and export every size each store asks for.
Can you enter the listing into App Store Connect and Play Console?
Yes, in the Premium package, using the access you give us as a team member. In the other packages you receive the text and images and paste them in yourself.
Do you follow store rules on keywords and claims?
Yes. We avoid competitor names, price claims you cannot keep, fake awards and keyword stuffing, all of which can get an update rejected or a listing removed.
